content.value: The current amount of space used by commercial businesses and offices in 2010 (15) is 8640000 sq. ft. and the population is 8640. Total expected number of additional people by the year 2020 is 864, estimate the need for new commercial space. Assume that the need for new space per person will increase at the same rate throughout your planning time period.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
